WebP codec — references/image/src/codecs/webp/ + image-webp@0.2.0 VP8L lossless decode (meta-Huffman, LZ77, color cache, 4 transforms) + literal-only VP8L encoder. VP8 lossy keyframe decode (vp8.nim). VP8 lossy keyframe decode (vp8.nim), incl. VP8X + ALPH transparency. Animation returns Unsupported. Bitstream: LSB-first. Pixels in buffer order R,G,B,A.

Imports

../color, ../error, ../buffer, ../dynamic, vp8

Types

MetaPlan = object
  bits*: int
  hx*, hy*: int
  tileGroup*: seq[int]
  groupFreqs*: seq[seq[int]]
  ops*: seq[uint8]
Vp8lScratch = object
  head*: PooledBuffer[int]
Reusable cross-encode scratch for VP8L encoding. Owns the LZ77 hash table (Vp8lHashSize ints, ~2 MB at default hash bits) across encodes, so batch encoding pays one backing instead of one per encode. Each parse fully refills the table, so reuse is output- identical. Fixed size per build (Vp8lHashBits intdefine); no shrink API needed. Not thread-safe — one per encoding thread.

Forward cross-color: R -= d(g2r,G); B -= d(g2b,G) + d(r2b,R_orig). (Decoder adds them back, using reconstructed R for the last term, which equals R_orig exactly.)

proc buildLens(freqs: openArray[int]; maxLen = 15): seq[uint16] {....raises: [],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}
Classic Huffman lengths with a libjpeg-style length-limit adjustment (cf. jpgenc genOptimalTable): deterministic, Kraft-valid, and capped at maxLen so the decoder's buildImplicit always accepts the table. 
proc chooseColorParams(px: seq[Rgba[uint8]]; w, h, sizeBits: int): seq[
    array[3, uint8]] {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Per-tile (g2r, g2b, r2b) as uint8 bit patterns. Least-squares estimate on signed residuals selects the start, then local-entropy refinement: red tries the +-2 neighborhood, blue coordinate-descends twice. Small bonus for zero/neighbor matches keeps the transform image compressible. The caller keeps the transform only if the actual payload with these params is smaller, so proposals stay aggressive.

ALPH chunk payload (after the 8-byte chunk header): 1 preamble byte +

payload starts at the 0x2f signature byte. Borrows the caller bytes (pointer + len, no copy); the reader never outlives this call. 
proc decodeVp8lHeaderless(payload: openArray[uint8]; w, h: int): ImageResult[
    RgbaImage] {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Headerless VP8L stream: no signature/dimension header, the payload starts at the transform bit. Used by the ALPH C==1 path, where dimensions come from the VP8X canvas / VP8 frame instead of the stream. Borrows the caller bytes like decodeVp8l.

proc distChoice(d, xsize: int; dcost: openArray[int]): tuple[sym, extra: int,
    ok: bool] {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Cheapest (prefix, extra) encoding pixel distance d, or ok=false when d is not encodable. Mirrors the decoder: a copyDist result n > 120 is a direct distance (d = n - 120), else a DistMap 2-D code (d = max(1, dx + dy * xsize)). 
proc encodeAlph(alpha: openArray[uint8]; w, h: int): seq[uint8] {....raises: [],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}
ALPH chunk payload (preamble + bitstream) for a w*h alpha plane.
Tries raw (C=0, F=0) vs headerless VP8L (C=1, F=0) and keeps the
smaller payload. The VP8L candidate reuses the full lossless encoder
on a gray image (alpha in every channel; the decoder reads green)
minus its 5-byte signature/dimension header, which is byte-aligned
(8 + 14 + 14 + 1 + 3 bits) with the stream starting fresh after it.

proc encodeVp8l(img: RgbaImage): seq[uint8] {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
VP8L encoder: predictor + subtract-green + (when they win) per-block color transform and meta-Huffman, LZ77 backward matches + color cache. Pixel-exact output any spec decoder accepts. Each optional stage is kept only when its actual payload is smaller (reference philosophy: never trust estimates).

    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
VP8L encoder reusing scratch across encodes. Bit-identical to encodeVp8l(img); only the LZ77 hash backing is retained between encodes (not pixels, not payloads). Pass a long-lived scratch when encoding many images in a row.
